{{Quote|The Duchess awaits you, General Kenobi.|The [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]], speaking to [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]|<ref name="The Mandalore Plot">{{TCW|The Mandalore Plot}}</ref>}}
When [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] arrived to Mandalore, '''this Mandalorian guard''' said that [[Duchess/Legends|Duchess]] [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze]] was waiting for him. He then brought Kenobi to the Palace where he would meet with the Duchess.

==Behind the scenes==
The Mandalorian Guard was voiced by [[Matt Lanter]], who also voiced [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] in [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''The Clone Wars'' TV series]].
